metaDescription: Order custom plastic lanyards and badges for your team. Durable, affordable, and perfect for daily use. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Plastic lanyards and badges offer a durable, lightweight solution for daily ID and access needs. Unlike fabric options, plastic resists moisture and stains, making them ideal for high-traffic environments like offices, schools, and trade shows. With easy-clean surfaces and vibrant color printing, they keep your branding sharp through repeated use. Choose from breakaway safety clasps or badge holders to suit your workplace requirements.
heroAltText: Custom plastic lanyards and badges with printed logos and breakaway clasps for office ID use
